description:
Watch Gogol Bordello perform "Boiling Point" live in studio
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Combining the sounds of punk rock, electronica and Eastern European folk, New York-based rock band Gogol Bordello are always pushing new musical boundaries. Their latest album, We Mean It, Man!, released on February 13, 2026, and it continues to showcase the band’s ever-growing sound. 

Shortly after the album’s release, Gogol Bordello visited The Current studio for a session hosted by Jill Riley. Watch a performance of "Boiling Point" above.

Musicians
Eugene Hütz – vocals, guitar
Sergey Ryabtsev – vocals, electric violin
Erica Mancini – vocals, synth, accordion
Pedro Segovia – vocals, sampler, cajon and other percussion

Credits
